name: Zackary Provost
career_history: Director of Preconstruction at P1 Group, 4/2026 to present; Senior Preconstruction Manager at P1 Group, 1/2023 to 4/2026; Senior Preconstruction Manager at U S Engineering, 10/2018 to 1/2023; Preconstruction Manager at U S Engineering, 1/2012 to 10/2018; Mechanical Engineer at Phillips+Gomez, 5/2008 to 1/2012
education: Bachelor of Science (B.S.), Architectural Engineering, Kansas State University, 2002 to 2008
biography: Zack brings 4 years of commercial design and 14 years of design-build and pre-construction experience. He has produced HVAC, plumbing, and control system designs through multiple delivery processes including design-build, design-assist, and design-bid-build. Since joining P1 Group, Zack has worked on multiple design-build and design-assist projects where his responsibilities have included conceptual and detailed design, estimating, value engineering, and consultant management for a diverse range of projects including health care, commercial high-rise, laboratories, central plants, retail buildings, data centers, and educational facilities.
